grammar.title: How long / how often / how much
grammar.rule: How long — продолжительность; how often — частота; how much — цена или количество неисчисляемого.
grammar.pattern: How long does it last? / How often do you meet?
grammar.example: How long does the beginner workshop last?
grammar.pitfall: Не путай how long (длительность) и how often (частота).
exercises: ___ does each workshop last? Two hours.
Complete: ___ often do you run beginner classes?
How much does the class cost
Complete: How ___ materials are included? Use many.
How long does the workshop last

phrases: How long does the beginner pottery session last?
Сколько длится занятие по керамике для начинающих?
Do I need any previous experience with clay?
Мне нужен предыдущий опыт работы с глиной?

reading.title: Choosing a beginner pottery workshop
paragraphs: Elena sees an advertisement for pottery workshops at a local studio. She has never worked with clay, so she looks for a beginner session rather than a course for experienced people. The studio offers a two-hour trial workshop on Saturday mornings. The fee includes the clay and the use of basic studio equipment. Elena asks whether she needs to bring her own apron.

The studio assistant explains that aprons are available for visitors. During the first session, beginners make a small bowl with the teacher's help. The bowl will not be ready to take home immediately because it needs more work at the studio. The assistant explains the later glazing session and collection process. Elena books one trial place and writes down the arrival time. She decides to try the class before committing to a longer course.
questions: Why does Elena choose a beginner session?
How long is the trial workshop?
Why does Elena book one trial place?
To try the class before a longer commitment
To collect a finished bowl immediately

dialogue: Elena
Hello. How long does your beginner pottery workshop last?
Здравствуйте. Сколько длится мастер-класс по керамике для начинающих?
Assistant
Two hours. We run a trial session every Saturday morning.
Два часа. Проводим пробное занятие каждую субботу утром.
Elena
Do I need previous experience, or can I come as a complete beginner?
Нужен предыдущий опыт или можно прийти совсем новичком?
Assistant
No experience is needed. The teacher will help you make a small bowl.
Опыт не требуется. Преподаватель поможет сделать небольшую миску.
Elena
How much is the workshop, and are the materials included?
Сколько стоит мастер-класс и входят ли материалы?
Assistant
The materials and apron are included in the price shown here.
Материалы и фартук включены в указанную цену.
Elena
Can I take the bowl home on the same day?
Могу забрать миску домой в тот же день?
Assistant
Not yet. We'll explain the glazing and collection dates at the studio.
Пока нет. Объясним даты глазурования и получения в студии.
listening: How often does the studio run the trial session?
speaking: Ask about the duration and frequency of a fictional creative workshop.
Explain why a trial class can be useful before a longer course.
Ask which materials the workshop fee includes.
Describe a hobby you would like to try as a beginner.

Write two questions each with how long, how often and how much.
Write a short booking confirmation with arrival time and materials.
pack.model: How long does the workshop last? How much does it cost? I'm a beginner. Could you tell me what materials are included?

pack.title: An early breakfast before the excursion

grammar.title: Before / after / when
grammar.rule: Before — раньше, after — позже, when — в момент события. В придаточном времени о будущем обычно Present Simple.
grammar.pattern: before the bus leaves / after we return
grammar.example: We'll have breakfast before the tour starts.
grammar.pitfall: Не говори before the tour will start в обычном временном придаточном.
exercises: Present Simple in future time clause.
Скажи: мы позавтракаем до начала экскурсии.
We will eat before the tour starts
I'll collect the key after I ___ breakfast.
Complete: We will leave when the driver ___ (come).

phrases: Our tour starts before the usual breakfast time.
Наша экскурсия начинается до обычного времени завтрака.
Is a packed breakfast available for early departures?
Доступен завтрак с собой при раннем отправлении?
Could we collect the breakfast boxes at six thirty?
Можем забрать коробки с завтраком в шесть тридцать?
When do we have to place the breakfast order?
Когда нужно сделать заказ завтрака?
We'll leave the guesthouse after we collect the food.
Мы уйдём из гостевого дома после получения еды.
Does the price include the packed option?
Цена включает вариант с собой?
Please put the room number on the breakfast order.
Укажите номер комнаты в заказе завтрака.
I'll confirm the pickup time with the tour organiser.
Подтвержу время выезда с организатором экскурсии.

Нужно что-нибудь простое, что можно взять с собой.

Проверю стойку регистрации до приезда водителя.

reading.title: An early breakfast before the excursion
paragraphs: Anton and his sister book an early excursion from a guesthouse. The driver is picking them up at seven, but the normal breakfast service starts at half past seven. Anton does not want to leave without arranging food, so he asks the host about an earlier option. The host explains that the kitchen cannot open before seven, but guests with early departures can request a packed breakfast.

They need to place the order before eight in the evening. Anton asks what is included and whether the box costs extra. The host offers a sandwich, fruit and a drink as part of their existing breakfast booking. The boxes will be available at reception from six thirty. Anton confirms the room number and pickup time in writing. The next morning they collect the boxes before the driver arrives and leave on time.
questions: When does the driver collect them?
Why do they request another option?
The restaurant is full at dinner
The usual breakfast starts too late
They want to cancel the tour

dialogue: Anton
Our tour driver is arriving at seven. Does breakfast start before then?
Водитель экскурсии приезжает в семь. Завтрак начинается раньше?
Host
The normal breakfast starts at seven thirty, but we can prepare a packed option.
Обычный завтрак начинается в семь тридцать, но можем приготовить вариант с собой.
Anton
That would help. When do we have to place the order?
Это поможет. Когда нужно сделать заказ?
Host
Before eight this evening. You can collect the boxes at reception at six thirty.
До восьми сегодня вечером. Забрать коробки можно на стойке в шесть тридцать.
Anton
Is the packed breakfast included in our booking?
Завтрак с собой включён в наше бронирование?
Host
Yes. It includes a sandwich, fruit and a drink.
Да. Включает сэндвич, фрукты и напиток.
Anton
Great. We'll collect the boxes before the driver arrives.
Отлично. Заберём коробки до приезда водителя.
Host
Please confirm your room number and we'll prepare them for you.
Подтвердите номер комнаты, и мы их подготовим.
listening: What time can they collect the boxes?
speaking: Explain why an early tour needs a different breakfast arrangement.
Ask a guesthouse about three available breakfast options.
Use before, after and when to describe tomorrow's sequence.
Confirm an order deadline and collection place.
Role-play requesting a packed breakfast without assuming extra services.
writing: Write a guesthouse message asking for breakfast before an early tour.
Write six future time-clause sentences with before, after and when.
Write a short itinerary from collecting breakfast to meeting the driver.
pack.model: Our driver arrives at seven. Could we collect a packed breakfast at six thirty? We'll place the order before eight tonight.

pack.title: An indoor climbing taster booking
pack.ru: Запись на пробное занятие в скалодроме
pack.goal: Уточнить требования к участию, уровень и включённые услуги без технических инструкций.

grammar.title: Have you ever / never
grammar.rule: Present Perfect: have/has + V3 для жизненного опыта без точной даты. Ever — когда-либо, never — никогда. При указании finished time используй Past Simple.
grammar.pattern: Have you ever tried it? / I've never tried it.
grammar.example: I've never been to this climbing centre.
grammar.pitfall: Не сочетай never и дополнительное not в этом значении.
exercises: Have you ever ___ a climbing centre?
Скажи: я никогда не пробовал скалолазание.
She ___ a taster session last Saturday.
Complete: Has he ever ___ (take) an introductory class?
Спроси: ты когда-нибудь посещал этот центр?
Have you ever visited this centre

phrases: Have you ever been to this climbing centre?
Ты когда-нибудь посещал этот скалодром?
I've never tried climbing before.
Я никогда прежде не пробовал скалолазание.
Is this session suitable for first-time participants?
Это занятие подходит тем, кто участвует впервые?
What are the requirements for taking part?
Какие требования для участия?
Does the booking include a supervised beginner class?
Бронирование включает занятие для новичков под наблюдением?
Could you send the participant information sheet?
Можете прислать информационный лист участника?
Is equipment hire included in the session price?
Аренда снаряжения входит в стоимость занятия?
I'd like to ask the instructor about the session first.
Сначала хотел бы спросить инструктора о занятии.
How early should participants arrive for registration?
Насколько раньше участникам нужно прибыть на регистрацию?
I'll follow the centre's instructions rather than guess.
Буду следовать указаниям центра, а не гадать.

reading.title: An indoor climbing taster booking
paragraphs: Lina's colleague invites her to try an indoor climbing centre. Lina has never been climbing and does not know whether the advertised taster session is designed for complete beginners. She reads the centre's information page and calls reception. The assistant explains that the taster is a supervised session with an instructor and that participants must meet the centre's published requirements.

Lina asks about the booking form, equipment hire and arrival time. The assistant sends her the participant information sheet so she can read it before deciding. Lina explains that she has no previous experience and wants to speak to the instructor before the session. The assistant confirms that this is possible. Lina checks the conditions and chooses a suitable date with her colleague. Her aim is to try a new hobby in an organised setting, not to practise independently without instruction.
questions: What kind of session is advertised?
Who does Lina want to speak to?

dialogue: Lina
Hello. I've never tried climbing. Is your taster session suitable for complete beginners?
Здравствуйте. Я никогда не пробовала скалолазание. Пробное занятие подходит совсем новичкам?
Assistant
Yes, it is supervised by an instructor. Please read the participant requirements first.
Да, оно проходит под наблюдением инструктора. Сначала ознакомьтесь с требованиями к участникам.
Lina
Have I got to bring any equipment of my own?
Мне нужно приносить собственное снаряжение?
Assistant
The standard equipment hire is included. The information sheet explains what to bring.
Стандартная аренда снаряжения включена. В информационном листе объяснено, что взять.
Lina
Can I speak to the instructor before taking part?
Могу поговорить с инструктором до участия?
Assistant
Of course. Arrive fifteen minutes before the booked session for registration.
Конечно. Приходите за пятнадцать минут до занятия на регистрацию.
Lina
Thanks. I'll read the requirements before confirming the booking.
Спасибо. Ознакомлюсь с требованиями до подтверждения записи.
Assistant
Certainly. I'll email the information sheet and available dates.
Конечно. Пришлю информационный лист и доступные даты по почте.

Explain the difference between life experience and a dated past event.
Ask a centre for requirements and instructor availability.
Role-play requesting information before confirming a new activity.
writing: Write an enquiry about a supervised beginner activity.
Write three ever questions and three never statements about hobbies.
Write a reply confirming that you will read participant requirements.
pack.model: I've never tried climbing before. Is the session suitable for beginners? Could you send the requirements and tell me when to arrive?

pack.title: A language exchange at the park
pack.goal: Договориться о языковой практике и разделить время между участниками.

grammar.title: Let's / shall we / how about
grammar.rule: Let's + начальная форма — предложение совместного действия; Shall we + начальная форма — вопрос-предложение; How about + -ing или существительное.
grammar.pattern: Let's practise / Shall we start? / How about meeting?
grammar.example: How about speaking English for the first twenty minutes?
grammar.pitfall: Не говори how about to speak.
exercises: How about ___ in the park tomorrow?
Let's + base verb; British/American spelling accepted.
Let us take a short break

phrases: Shall we start with twenty minutes of English?
Начнём с двадцати минут английского?
How about choosing hobbies as our first topic?
Как насчёт выбора хобби первой темой?
Let's share the speaking time equally.
Разделим время разговора поровну.
Would you prefer corrections during the conversation or afterwards?
Предпочитаешь исправления во время разговора или после?
Could you repeat that expression a little more slowly?
Можешь повторить это выражение немного медленнее?
I'll write down the words I want to review later.
Запишу слова, которые хочу повторить позже.
Shall we switch languages after the first part?
Переключим язык после первой части?
We can use a conversation card if we run out of ideas.
Можем воспользоваться карточкой темы, если закончатся идеи.
Let's choose a quieter bench for the next meeting.
Выберем более тихую скамейку для следующей встречи.
Thanks for giving me time to finish my answer.
Спасибо, что дал мне время закончить ответ.

reading.title: A language exchange at the park
paragraphs: Rosa meets a language exchange partner at a park on Sunday. She wants to practise English, and her partner wants to practise Russian. They have one hour together, so they agree to spend twenty-five minutes on each language and leave ten minutes for a short break and review. They choose hobbies as their first conversation topic and prepare a few questions about weekend activities.

Before starting, Rosa asks how her partner prefers to receive corrections. He would like to finish each answer before discussing mistakes. Rosa agrees and asks for the same approach in English. They write down useful expressions rather than interrupt every sentence. After the first part, they switch languages as planned. At the end, they compare notes and arrange another meeting. Both leave with a small list of expressions to review.
questions: How long do they have together?
How long do they spend on each language?

dialogue: Rosa
Shall we start with English for twenty-five minutes?
Начнём с английского на двадцать пять минут?
Partner
Good idea. How about talking about hobbies first?
Хорошая идея. Как насчёт разговора о хобби сначала?
Rosa
Let's do that. Do you prefer corrections during an answer or afterwards?
Давай. Предпочитаешь исправления во время ответа или после?
Partner
Afterwards, please. I'd like to finish what I'm saying.
После, пожалуйста. Хотел бы закончить то, что говорю.
Rosa
Same for me. We can write down difficult words as we go.
Мне тоже. Можем записывать трудные слова по ходу.
Partner
Shall we switch to Russian after the first twenty-five minutes?
Переключимся на русский после первых двадцати пяти минут?
Rosa
Yes, and let's leave ten minutes for review and a short break.
Да, и оставим десять минут на повторение и короткий перерыв.
Partner
Perfect. Let's start with a question about your favourite hobby.
Отлично. Начнём с вопроса о твоём любимом хобби.
listening: When will they switch to Russian?
At the end of the hour

Explain a useful phrase you learned during a conversation.

writing: Write a friendly message arranging a one-hour language exchange.
Write three suggestions with let's, shall we and how about.
Write a brief review list after a fictional conversation.
pack.model: Shall we speak English for twenty-five minutes? How about starting with hobbies? Let's save difficult expressions for review at the end.

pack.title: A small museum with an audio guide
pack.goal: Уточнить доступные языки, порядок использования и возврата аудиогида.

grammar.title: Which / what / whose
grammar.rule: Which — выбор из ограниченного набора; what — общий вопрос; whose — принадлежность. Вопросительное слово стоит перед существительным или глагольной группой.
grammar.pattern: Which language? / What is included? / Whose guide is this?
grammar.example: Which language would you like for the guide?
grammar.pitfall: Не путай whose (чей) и who's (who is).
exercises: ___ language would you prefer, English or French?
Complete: ___ audio guide is this? Ask about ownership.
Спроси: что входит в стоимость билета?
What is included in the ticket price
___ of these two routes is shorter?
Complete: ___ language options are available? Use what.

phrases: Which languages are available on the audio guide?
Какие языки доступны в аудиогиде?
What does the short exhibition route include?
Что включает короткий выставочный маршрут?
Could you show me the language selection screen?
Покажите экран выбора языка.
Do I enter the number printed beside the exhibit?
Мне вводить номер, напечатанный возле экспоната?
Is the audio guide included in the admission price?
Аудиогид включён в стоимость входа?
Where do I return the guide after the visit?
Куда вернуть аудиогид после посещения?
Whose audio guide receipt is this?
Чья это квитанция аудиогида?
I'd prefer the English commentary for language practice.
Предпочёл бы английский комментарий для языковой практики.
Can I pause the recording and listen again?
Могу поставить запись на паузу и прослушать снова?
Please show me where the volume control is.
Покажите, где регулятор громкости.

reading.title: A small museum with an audio guide
paragraphs: Nina visits a small museum during a weekend trip. At the entrance, she sees that audio guides are available in several languages. She wants to practise listening in English, so she chooses the English commentary instead of her first language. The attendant explains that visitors can select a short route or a longer commentary covering the whole exhibition.

Nina has only an hour before meeting a friend, so she chooses the short route. The attendant shows her how to select the language and enter the number printed beside an exhibit. Nina asks whether the guide is included in admission and where to return it. The hire fee is separate, and the return counter is near the exit. She keeps the receipt, listens to several exhibits and repeats difficult passages. Before leaving, she returns the guide and meets her friend on time.
questions: Why does she choose the short route?
How does she choose an exhibit commentary?
Where does she return the guide?

dialogue: Nina
Which languages are available on your audio guides?
Какие языки доступны в ваших аудиогидах?
Attendant
English, French and German. Which would you prefer?
Английский, французский и немецкий. Какой предпочитаете?
Nina
English, please. What does the short route include?
Английский, пожалуйста. Что включает короткий маршрут?
Attendant
It covers the main exhibits and takes about forty minutes.
Он охватывает основные экспонаты и занимает около сорока минут.
Nina
Is the guide included in the admission price?
Аудиогид включён в стоимость входа?
Attendant
No, the hire fee is separate. Here is the guide and receipt.
Нет, плата за аренду отдельная. Вот аудиогид и квитанция.
Nina
Where do I return it after the visit?
Куда его вернуть после посещения?
Attendant
At the counter by the exit. Please keep the receipt until then.
На стойку у выхода. Сохраните квитанцию до этого момента.
listening: How long does the short route take?
speaking: Ask a museum attendant about available languages and routes.
Use which to choose between two defined options.
Use what to ask about included services.
Ask whose receipt or device you have found.
Role-play returning a borrowed audio guide after a visit.
writing: Write a museum enquiry asking about an English audio guide.
Write two questions each with which, what and whose.
Write a brief account of using an audio guide for listening practice.
pack.model: Which languages are available? What does the short route include? I'd like the English guide. Where do I return it?
